claims.text: Pulse oximetry in all pts; CXR unless it = clearly a mild flare of a known condition.
claims.quote: Pulse oximetry should be performed in all patients, and chest radiography should be done as well unless symptoms are clearly caused by a mild or moderate exacerbation of a known condition.

claims.text: ECG in most adults for ischemia, w ♡ biomarkers if sus = ↑.
claims.quote: Most adults should have an ECG to detect myocardial ischemia (and serum cardiac biomarker testing if suspicion is high) unless myocardial ischemia can be excluded clinically.

claims.text: ABG if breathing = severe or worsening; a BMP's bicarb shows how chronic a resp acidosis =.
claims.quote: In patients with severe or deteriorating respiratory status, arterial blood gases (ABGs) should be measured

claims.text: PE: CTA or V/Q scan @ mod or ↑risk; D-dimer @ ↓risk.
claims.quote: Patients who have no clear diagnosis after chest radiograph and ECG and are at moderate or high risk of having pulmonary embolism (based on a clinical prediction rule) should undergo CT angiography or ventilation/perfusion scanning. Patients who are at low risk may have D-dimer testing
